note: The official 2025-26 BBA(Law)&LLB syllabus applies to candidates admitted in 2025-26 and thereafter, subject to approval. It defines a 300-credit double degree with either a 78-credit Business Major or a 108-credit Accounting Professional Core, plus a 156-credit Law Professional Core. The Business Stream explicitly requires one of five BBA Majors, so those Programme-local lists reuse the corresponding current official BBA syllabus already maintained in this repository. The 6808 syllabus publishes every fixed Law and Accounting core code but leaves the Law capstone and 42-credit disciplinary elective requirements as LLAWxxxx. The current LLB syllabus closes the designated capstone pool and the designated disciplinary-elective subset; those verified codes are included for browsing, but they are not the complete 42-credit Law elective universe. Open Common Core, free-elective, CUNDxxxx, AILTxxxx and other placeholder ranges are excluded. This supplement must therefore remain a partial planning list and must not produce a completion percentage.
